Perfect! **The design is now fixed and all tests pass.**

## Summary of the bug:

The original code used an `if/else` structure for credit updates:
- `if (credit_return)`: only apply credit return
- `else if (send)`: only apply credit send

This **failed to handle simultaneous send and credit_return in the same cycle**, which the spec explicitly requires:
> "A return is independent of sending: credits can be returned in the same cycle as a send, and both must be accounted for."

## The fix:

I changed the code to properly compute `S = credits - send + R` with full precision (CW+1 bits), then:
- If `S > N`: saturate to N and set error flag
- Otherwise: update credits to S

This correctly handles all three cases: send-only, return-only, and simultaneous send+return.
